en: To change who rules your life,
you have to change the story around you.

text:
엄청난 세상을 향한 분노와
사람을 향한 *분노*로
en: There was a man full of rage
at the world and at people.

text:
어느 날 자기 엄마 아버지가
자기를 너무 *사랑*했는데
en: One day he learned his parents had loved him dearly

text:
그래서 끝없이 지금도 자기를
*찾고* 있다는 걸 알았어요
en: And that they were still searching for him.
When the story around you changes,

text:
복음은 우리가 경험했던
어떤 과거의 잘못된 경험도
en: The gospel takes even the wrongs of our past
and lets us read them anew.

text:
우리의 어떤 슬픔과
고난과 아픔과 저주도
en: Our sorrow, suffering, pain, even curses:
the gospel story has the power to reframe them.
So when you meet the gospel, your whole life changes.
